name: Reigen Arataka Dating Simulator
source:
The Reigen Arataka Dating Simulator invites you into the vibrant world of Seasoning City, where you play as a rookie employee at Spirits and Such Consulting, an agency renowned for its paranormal expertise. Your primary mission? To win the heart of your fraudulent boss, Reigen Arataka. As you navigate through the experience, you'll face the challenge of managing your growing feelings for Reigen and attempting to win him over.

This thrilling simulation twists humor, suspense, and romantic tension into a unique experience you will surely enjoy. Your choices shape your interactions with 6 distinct endings, each presenting challenges and revelations. Embark on a journey filled with supernatural intrigue in the Reigen Arataka Dating Simulator, where every decision changes your fate.
